title: Mitochondrial fitness in circulating T cells predicts neoadjuvant therapy response in locally advanced colorectal cancer.
snippet: Traditional immunophenotyping based on cell counts has limited value in predicting neoadjuvant treatment outcomes for locally advanced colorectal cancer (LACRC). Because mitochondrial fitness is an essential factor in T-cell function, we hypothesized that the pretreatment metabolic profile of circulating T cells could predict therapeutic response.
